summary: CCH Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement (SPA) with non-U.S. purchasers to issue up to 15,000,000 class A ordinary shares at $0.276 per share under Regulation S. Net proceeds will fund working capital; no board advisor, premium, shareholder vote, or regulatory clock is mentioned due to the private placement nature. The filing is a routine capital-raising current report, not a special situation. There is no risk arb angle; the transaction is a standard exempt offering with customary representations and conditions.
